titulo: AdrianLAB por dentro (lobby / piso de arriba)
prompt: Playful, slightly sneaky indoor theme for a 1990s point-and-click adventure game set inside an eccentric tech lab office. Memorable muted trumpet melody, vibraphone and harpsichord comping, comic bassoon counter-line, walking upright bass, brushed drums with rimshots. High-quality General MIDI light orchestral jazz feel. 90 BPM, G major, 4/4. Instrumental only, seamless loop.

A.descripcion: calm: vibraphone and harpsichord comp softly, muted trumpet plays the main melody quietly, walking bass, very light drums, good for background while characters talk

B.descripcion: more energy: trumpet and bassoon play the melody in octaves, busier walking bass, rimshot groove, vibraphone flourishes, cadence back to G major so it loops
